integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled exact-rational checker replays the witness and the two-eigenvalue projective identity. Literature comparisons distinguish the standard cubic RQI map and known positivity motivation from the exact cone classification.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for irreducible two-by-two symmetric positive-definite Stieltjes matrices in exact arithmetic. No higher-dimensional, nonsymmetric, inexact-solve, or floating-point classification is claimed.
title: Exact two-dimensional positivity law for Rayleigh quotient iteration on Stieltjes matrices
